name: Samsung FL WF6000R Washer Motor Winding Resistance
purpose: DD motor stator — any two of three terminals at motor connector. §4-3 3C cites 6.0 Ω @ 25°C (not 19.3 Ω TL or 15 Ω §3 rear-motor checkpoint).
failureModes: Unequal pairs — rotor/stator or harness fault
testingTips: Rule out 3E overload before condemning motor
Smart Install manual check step 8 exercises spin

name: Samsung FL WF6000R Motor Hall Sensor
purpose: Hall sensor on main PCB motor connector — pins 1–3 and 1–4 expect approx. 2–4 MΩ per §4-3 3C.
failureModes: Low or open hall sensor — 3C with good motor windings
Connector moisture — dry harness before replace
testingTips: Measure at four-pin motor connector on main PBA side
Verify voltage when powered on if resistance borderline

name: Samsung FL WF6000R Wash Heater Resistance (bench)
purpose: Heater element removed from tub — 27.1 Ω (1900 W) or 26.2 Ω (2000 W) per §3.
testingTips: Ensure heater seated in bracket on reassembly

name: Samsung FL WF6000R Wash Heater In-Circuit (A–B)
purpose: Heater terminals A and B at tub front per §4-3 HC corrective TYPE 1.
failureModes: Good heater ohms but HC — check wash thermistor TYPE 2
testingTips: Disconnect power before accessing heater terminals
If TYPE 1 OK, replace wash thermistor at back of tub

name: Samsung FL WF6000R Wash Thermistor (room temp)
purpose: Wash heater NTC at room temperature — ~12 kΩ per §3 thermistor check point.
failureModes: Open/shorted NTC — TC1 / HC after heater ruled out
Frozen hose in winter — defrost before condemning sensor
testingTips: Measure at thermistor connector with leads attached
Compare after heater A–B passes TYPE 1 check

name: Samsung FL WF6000R Door Switch (TYPE 1 pins 1–3)
purpose: Door switch TYPE 1 — resistance pins 1 and 3 approximately 175 Ω per §4-3 DC.
failureModes: 120 V door feed — verify insulation before ohms
testingTips: Disconnect power — 120 V present on door circuit when energized
TYPE 2 lock slider pushed: pins 2–3 expect 60–90 Ω

name: Samsung FL WF6000R Door Lock Switch (TYPE 2 pins 2–3)
purpose: Door lock switch with slider pushed — pins 2–3 approximately 60–90 Ω per §4-3 DC1.
failureModes: Out of range — replace door lock assembly
DC1 persists — main PBA door sensing circuit
testingTips: Push lock slider to simulate latched state
Lock motor 1–2 pin: 46.57 ± 15 Ω for add-door variants

name: Samsung FL WF6000R Door Lock Motor (pins 1–2)
purpose: Add-door lock motor coil 46.57 ± 15 Ω at pins 1–2 per §4-3 DDC/DC3.
failureModes: Open coil — add door / barrier lock fault
Mechanical bind — check barrier pillars before electrical
testingTips: Verify lock stroke and detection switches mechanically
Press door switch button and confirm resistance changes

name: Samsung FL WF6000R Water Level Sensor Frequency (no load)
purpose: Pressure level sensor — approx. 25.5 kHz with no load on pink and orange wires per §4-3 1C.
failureModes: Out of band — replace water level sensor
Wrong material-code sensor installed — verify part number
testingTips: Connect sensor and harness before frequency check
Verify hose not folded, cut, or clogged with lubricant
